sources.title: PickleBall: Secure Deserialization of Pickle-based Machine Learning Models
sources.snippet: In this work, we propose a novel approach to secure pickle model deserialization, which we focus on for three reasons. First, pickle is a popular exchange format for models: repositories with pickle models are downloaded over 2.1 billion times per month from the Hugging Face model hub (§ 3.1).
